item.title: Headscale Deployment and Usage Guide: Mastering Tailscale's Self-Hosting Basics for Ultimate Control
item.description: Headscale is an open-source server that works like Tailscale’s control server. You can run it yourself instead of using Tailscale’s hosted service. This gives you full control over your VPN
